signature: _preview_local_backend_configuration(backend: str, paths: WizardPaths, removed_overrides: tuple[str, ...], toml_updates: dict[str, str]) -> str
pre_condition: backend is a non-empty string identifying a local CLI backend and is not 'opencode'. paths is a WizardPaths instance whose toml_path and env_path attributes are resolvable Path objects. removed_overrides is a tuple of zero or more non-empty strings each naming a dotenv entry to be removed. toml_updates is a dict mapping dot-separated TOML field paths to non-empty string values.
post_condition: Returns a human-readable multi-line string that identifies the backend being configured, lists the files that will be updated (always including paths.toml_path), and states that no API key or OpenCode provider configuration will be changed. When removed_overrides is non-empty: the .env file path is included in the file list, every entry in removed_overrides is named as a legacy override to be removed, and, when toml_updates contains entries whose keys are 'name' or 'effort', those key-value pairs are listed as model settings being retained from .env and written to TOML. When removed_overrides is empty: the string includes a note that no legacy LLM overrides were found in the project .env file. Returns without side effects on the filesystem or any configuration file.
